 Best of Storytelling: Donald Miller 
 
 Best of Storytelling: Donald Miller Aug 24, 2026

 This
week’s Summer Series is a two-fer on
the essential skill of storytelling. Whether
pitching an investment fund to a prospect, an idea to a portfolio
manager or CIO, or a request of a family member, storytelling
helps you get what you
want. 

 
To help understand the art and science of storytelling, Matt
Dicks – a retired middle school teacher and author of the
best-seller Storyworthy, and Don Miller – creator
of Storybrand, a business started with his book of the same
name – describe how to improve your storytelling
ability.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
